solutions.title: Repeated scan
solutions.strategy: For each project slot, scan all unused projects and pick the affordable project with maximum profit.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of up to k selections scans all n projects.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A used marker tracks projects that have already been selected.

solutions.title: Capital sort profit heap
solutions.strategy: Sort projects by required capital and push newly affordable profits into a max-heap.

timeComplexity.class: O(n log n + k log n)
timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting costs n log n and each project enters the heap once; each selection pops one profit.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The sorted project list and heap can store n projects.
